plain_english_policy: Enactment would authorize a specific use of existing funds in the Shoals Economic Development Fund to construct a Workforce Training and Development Center on property owned by Northwest-Shoals Community College, matching up to $5 million. This expands the fund's permitted uses beyond general industrial development (factories, warehouses) to include dedicated workforce training infrastructure.
policy_direction_if_enacted: The policy direction is targeted economic development through education infrastructure in Lauderdale and Colbert Counties. By funding a specific center for workforce training, the bill aims to improve local job readiness and support business retention/expansion by ensuring a skilled labor pool, distinct from general industrial subsidies or retail incentives which are explicitly excluded.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Morrow (N & P) advanced the bill to authorize this specific construction project using existing fund resources.
evidence_quotes: To expend an equal match of up to five million dollars ($5,000,000), which shall be expended to construct a Workforce Training and Development Center on property owned by Northwest-Shoals Community College.

Relating to Lauderdale and Colbert Counties; to amend Section 45-17-91.23, Code of Alabama 1975, relating to the Shoals Economic Development Fund; to provide that a portion of the Shoals Economic Development Fund may be used to build a Workforce Training and Development Center.
